criteria.long: The task spans multiple modules or large files (>32k input tokens).
criteria.medium: The task inspects one or two modules of moderate size (4k-32k input tokens).
criteria.short: The task is a compact single-snippet or localized edit (<4k input tokens).

context_band.instructions: Select the expected input context band required to ground this task.

criteria.false: Direct structured emission or straightforward code application is sufficient.
criteria.true: Multi-step causal analysis, invariant verification, or architectural synthesis is needed.

reasoning_required.instructions: Does this task require explicit chain-of-thought reasoning to avoid structural failure?

criteria.T0: Trivial formatting, docstring, typo, or single-line comment change with zero behavioral impact.
criteria.T1: Standard localized implementation, unit test addition, or routine single-file code edit.
criteria.T2: Multi-file refactor, DAG planning, structured judgment, or complex debugging.
criteria.T3: High-stakes concurrency, cryptographic invariant, distributed protocol, or security architecture.

tier.instructions: Select the minimum capability tier (T0, T1, T2, T3) required to complete this task reliably. Never name a provider or model brand.
